overview_description.description: VMware is a software company providing cloud and virtualization services that help complex digital infrastructure. The company accelerates digital transformation by enabling unprecedented freedom and flexibility in how its customers build and evolve IT environments. Its software helps business users simply and securely access the apps and data they need, from anywhere, to do their best work. The company's software spans compute, cloud, networking and security, and digital workspace.

press_references.value: Fresh court filings try to keep the case about copyright, and in US courts

legal_proceedings.description: VMware, a Broadcom business, filed a copyright lawsuit in March in the US District Court for the District of Delaware accusing Siemens of improperly obtaining and using a large number of unlicensed VMware software products. Siemens is seeking to move the case to Germany and recast it as a contractual dispute, while VMware has submitted fresh filings opposing that move and insisting on copyright grounds in US courts.

press_references.value: VMware and Siemens spar over where to stage software licence showdown

legal_proceedings.description: VMware has filed a lawsuit against Siemens, alleging that Siemens and its US affiliates used unlicensed VMware software. Siemens is seeking to have the case dismissed in the US, arguing that disputes should be resolved in Germany per their contract. The legal dispute is ongoing.

press_references.value: Unknown attackers exploit VMware hypervisor-hijack holes

legal_proceedings.description: Broadcom has released patches for three critical VMware hypervisor vulnerabilities that have been exploited by attackers. The vulnerabilities, identified as CVE-2025-22224, CVE-2025-22225, and CVE-2025-22226, affect various VMware products. Microsoft reported these bugs, which allow attackers with admin access to a VM to gain control of the hypervisor. Organizations are urged to update their systems to prevent exploitation by ransomware groups.
